assets.name: will i dream
assets.author: GANTASMO
assets.summary: Compound duple at 118.79 bpm that steps into additive 33/8 twice.
assets.description: Three minutes thirty-eight of audio on one track, opening at 118.79 bpm in 6/8. Six locators mark where the meter changes: the song leaves 6/8 at 0:31 for a passage of 33/8 grouped 3+2+3+3, returns, and leaves again at 2:54 for 33/8 grouped 3+2+2+2+2. Locator colour follows bar-length family, so the additive passages are visible on the timeline without reading the names. The tempo stays near 118 throughout and the engine marks most of the 6/8 stretches as uncertain, which is what a dense mix with a weak downbeat looks like to it. Press MAP in DETAILS to run the analysis and compare the result against the markers. A cockpit scene built for this song ships alongside it.

assets.name: House of the Rising Sun
assets.author: GANTASMO
assets.summary: Four and a half minutes that accelerate from 162 to 199 bpm, through 5/8 and two groupings of 12/8.
assets.description: The project opens at 162 bpm in 6/8. An amber locator at 0:39 marks the tempo change to 199, where the song stays. Eight more locators follow the meter: 5/8 grouped 2+3, a 12/8 passage grouped in twos, a long stretch of 6/8, and a second 12/8 grouped 3+2+2+3+2. The engine read a swing ratio of 1.28 here, so the eighths are audibly uneven rather than straight. Open SING to put the lyric beside the score, and DETAILS to read the map and export it.

assets.name: Miracle Mile
assets.author: GANTASMO
assets.summary: Six and a quarter minutes at 98.96 bpm, with six named scenes ready in the PERFORM grid.
assets.description: Six scenes are named in the project, so the PERFORM grid opens with a row per section: Intro, Verse, Turn, Chorus, Break and Out. Thirteen locators cover four tempo changes and nine meter segments, moving between 2/4, 4/4, an 8/4 passage grouped 3+3+2, and 6/4. The engine found cross-rhythms at 4:3 and 2:3 in three separate segments, which is the pulse the 8/4 passage is playing against. A cockpit scene built for this song ships alongside it.

assets.name: Gravy
assets.author: GANTASMO
assets.summary: Five minutes at 115.72 bpm carrying a three-stage mastering chain you can read and change.
assets.description: The audio track has an EQ, a compressor and a reverb on it, one of each, with values written into the project: the EQ lifts the low and high bands and cuts the mids, the compressor sits at -18 dB with a ratio of 2.5 and a 12 ms attack, and the reverb is 12 percent wet in a small room. Open MIX to see the chain, bypass a stage and hear what it was doing. Ten locators follow the meter, which opens in 6/8, moves into 9/8 at 0:58, returns, plays a passage of 15/8 grouped 2+3 at 2:46, and closes in 9/8.

assets.name: Everything is Chrome in the Future
assets.file: projects/Everything is Chrome in the Future.tasmo
assets.author: GANTASMO
assets.summary: Five and a half minutes at a steady tempo, on a single track with four locators.
assets.description: One audio track with fades at both ends, no tempo change, and four locators covering the whole song. The timeline is the thing to learn here: drag the clip, split it, move the playhead between locators. Then open DETAILS, press MAP, and export the report to see what a full analysis of a track contains.

assets.name: will i dream (cockpit scene)
assets.author: GANTASMO
assets.summary: The SwayCommand cockpit scene built for this song.
assets.description: Installs into the cockpit's project list, where the SWAY tab opens it. Set the SWAY tab's Audio source to theDAW master and play the song: the scene reacts to what theDAW is putting out, so it needs no audio file of its own.

assets.summary: A control surface packaged as a .gan, with its artwork and canvas surfaces.
